Laravel API Documentation

Postman collection → OpenAPI spec →

Introduction

OlympX sports platform REST API — organisations, tournaments, matches, scoring, rankings, sponsorships.

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000 
All routes except `GET /api/health` require **Laravel Sanctum** authentication.

Send a **Bearer token** in the `Authorization` header. Create a token for a user programmatically (`$user->createToken('scribe')`) or use your app's token flow.

Documentation is publicly readable; authenticated calls from **Try It Out** still need a valid Bearer token where required.

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Issue a Personal Access Token with Sanctum: $user->createToken('docs')->plainTextToken (e.g. a Tinker one-liner) or reuse your SPA token workflow. Optionally set SCRIBE_AUTH_KEY in .env when running scribe:generate so response extraction uses a real token.
